datasets.name: PlanetScope imagery
datasets.verbatim: The satellite images were taken from the Planet Labs Inc. PlanetScope, which includes more than 130 Dove satellites that provide 3 m spatial resolution multispectral images in four bands

datasets.name: ALOS PALSAR digital elevation model
datasets.verbatim: We extracted the slope data from the 12.5-m resolution digital elevation model (DEM) that was created from the ALOS PALSAR data.

datasets.name: Landslide inventory of Kodagu district
datasets.verbatim: In this study, a training dataset of polygons of the landslides for the Kodagu district was prepared from a manual delineation of landslides based on high-resolution PlanetScope imagery.

methods.name: Convolutional neural network (CNN)
methods.summary: A CNN architecture with five and six input layers (optical bands and slope data) using max pooling layers, trained in eCognition software to produce landslide probability maps.
methods.verbatim: Our structured CNN model was prepared and trained in Trimble’s eCognition software (eCognition Developer 2020).

reproducibility_assessment: The landslide inventory and input datasets are mentioned but not linked or made available, and the custom CNN code lacks a repository or persistent link.
